technical-summary: Added absolute turn ceiling (2700s) in GptAutoSessionTransport._wait_for_response() and outer backstop (3000s) in session dispatch _dispatch_session_request(). Without these, a stalled activity signal keeps the poll loop going forever, and SessionRuntime._call() awaits .result(timeout=None) — a dead stream stays 'running' indefinitely. The ceiling returns whatever partial text was captured and lets the turn reach a terminal state instead of blocking forever. Mirrors the activity-verified watchdog policy from SH22's _ABSOLUTE_SAFETY_CEILING_SECONDS in the gateway worker.
user-summary-candidate: GPT Auto turns can no longer hang forever: absolute 2700s ceiling returns partial text and reaches terminal state, with a 3000s outer backstop at dispatch.
